title: Tuberium system spec
description: One document that fully describes an agent system: its agents (circles/houses), its lines (who can talk to who) and its tasks. The map edits it, the backend runs it, a preset is a saved copy of it. No theme data lives here.

preset.description: Id of the preset this system was copied from, if any. Custom systems leave it out.

agentId.description: "you" is reserved for the human circle the app always draws next to the overseer.

level.description: off: the agent cannot do it. ask: it must ask you first, every time. allow: it can do it on its own.

readFiles.description: Read files in this system's workspace folder.

writeFiles.description: Create and edit files in this system's workspace folder.

runCode.description: Run code, e.g. Python for data cleaning.

postSocial.description: Publish posts to your social accounts.

submitForms.description: Fill in and submit online forms as you, e.g. job applications.

trade.description: Buy, sell and move money in your connected brokerage account, within the trade caps.

kind.description: Every system has exactly one overseer.

template.description: Which agent from the library this came from (researcher, writer, ...). Themes use it to pick the house and character.

purpose.description: Short paragraph: what this agent is for. Shown in the agent panel and given to the agent as its role.

model.description: Optional model id. Leave out to use the app default.

maxTradeUsd.description: Largest single trade this agent may place. The daily cap in backend/.env applies on top.

line.description: A line means these two agents can talk and hand each other files. No line, no talking: the engine blocks it.

twoWay.description: false: only `from` can start a conversation; `to` can still answer.

oneOf.description: On demand: runs when you press the button.

cron.description: Standard 5-field cron: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week

oneOf.description: Always on: a cheap check (no AI) runs every few minutes. The agents only wake up when it finds something.

task.description: A job for the system. It always goes to the overseer first, who plans the road and hands out the work.

goal.description: What done looks like. May use {{key}} for any of this task's inputs.

maxCostUsd.description: Hard spending cap for one run of this task, across all agents.
